description.short: AI-powered commerce and gig income intelligence platform.
description.medium: UnifyOne is the AI platform where your numbers actually matter. Built for gig workers, freelancers, small businesses, and developers who want financial intelligence that knows their real data.
description.long: UnifyOne is 1Commerce's AI-powered platform for people who work for themselves. Gig workers see what they're actually earning per hour after expenses. Freelancers price work based on their real history, not a calculator's guess. Small business operators run their shops with AI that knows their margins. Developers route across every major LLM provider through one API with zero lock-in. Your money. Your AI. One platform.
